questions.question: What is Harrison Ford’s character called in American Graffiti?
questions.note: Ford plays the swaggering racer who challenges John Milner in George Lucas’s 1973 hit.

questions.question: In The Conversation, what is Harrison Ford’s character named?
questions.note: Stett works for the client whose conversation is being secretly recorded.

questions.question: Force 10 from Navarone is a sequel to which World War II film?
questions.note: Ford appears in the 1978 follow-up to the 1961 war-film classic.

questions.question: In The Frisco Kid, Harrison Ford plays a cowboy opposite Gene Wilder’s rabbi. What is Ford’s character named?
questions.note: Ford plays the outlaw who helps a Polish rabbi cross the American West.

questions.question: In Hanover Street, Harrison Ford plays an American pilot during which war?
questions.note: Ford plays bomber pilot David Halloran in the 1979 romantic drama.

questions.question: In Heroes, what is Harrison Ford’s Vietnam veteran character named?
questions.note: Ford co-stars with Henry Winkler in the 1977 film.

questions.question: In Journey to Shiloh, what is Harrison Ford’s character named?
questions.note: Ford appears in the 1968 Civil War film early in his screen career.

questions.question: In Apocalypse Now, Harrison Ford plays which military officer?
questions.note: It is a brief briefing-room appearance in Coppola’s Vietnam War epic.

questions.question: Which Ford film features a 19th-century rabbi traveling through the American West?
questions.note: Gene Wilder plays the rabbi in this 1979 Western comedy.

questions.question: In Force 10 from Navarone, what is Harrison Ford’s commando named?
questions.note: Ford leads a mission into Yugoslavia in the 1978 war-film sequel.
